texts.zh:
就像暗室里低沉的轻语般，虚境从内心召唤我们。那是时间开始运转的伊始便存在的由纯粹灵能构成的原生领域。所有被赐予灵能能力的生物都能用某种方式，即使只是潜意识地，从虚境汲取能量。

自从我们升格之后，我们开始更清晰地看到虚境。其中有些图案，即使是我们最强大的通灵者看到的也只是毫无格式的漩涡状能量。在虚境那边，也有一些……其他的存在。一种灵体样的存在，从另一边凝视着我们，有时怀着好奇，有时怀着善意……有时也怀着恶意。

我们还在进一步学习我们这新得力量的延展面，但我们还是有可能和这些灵体交流的，这需要我们最强大的通灵者们的共同努力。
texts.en:
Like a muffled whisper in a dark room, the Shroud calls to us from within our minds. It is a primordial realm of pure psychic energy that came into being at the dawn of time. All creatures that have been gifted with psionic abilities tap into the Shroud in some way to draw power, even if only subconsciously.

Since our transcendence, we have begun to see the Shroud with greater clarity. There are patterns where once even our strongest telepaths could see only a formless mass of swirling energy. There are... other things, as well. Spirits of a sort, that gaze back on us from the other side. Sometimes with curiosity, sometimes with kindness... and sometimes with malice.

We are still in the process of learning the extent of our new powers, but it may be possible for us to commune with these spirits. It will require the combined efforts of our most powerful telepaths.

texts.zh: 如果我们要和被称为“虚境”的灵能领域中的居民交流的话，我们必须释放一股难以想象的巨大灵能能量。一场巨大的降灵会已做好筹备，[Root.Capital.GetName]新建的灵能使密会所里最强大的通灵者们将参与其中。
texts.en: If we are to communicate with the denizens of the psychic realm known as the Shroud, we will have to unleash an incredible amount of psionic energy. Preparations have been made for a huge séance involving our most powerful psychics in the newly established Conclave of Telepaths on [Root.Capital.GetName].

texts.zh:
经过了数天的催眠出神后，灵能使密会的通灵者们终于开启了一道通往虚境的短暂穿界门。

现在已经建立了初步的灵能链接，以后就能通过接触菜单和虚境交流了。为了和这一领域建立有意义的连接并会见身居其中的存在，我们有必要用一种特殊的灵能发射器延展灵能范围，这会消耗一笔巨量的能量。
texts.en:
After days of being locked in an hypnotic trance, our psychics in the Conclave of Telepaths have finally managed to open a brief gateway into the Shroud.

Now that we have established an initial psionic link, we will be able to access the Shroud through the Contacts menu in the future. To make any kind of meaningful forays into this realm and meet the beings who dwell there, we will likely have to make use of special psionic emitters to extend our psychic reach. This will consume a tremendous amount of energy.

label.zh: 是时候进入了，看看我们能发现什么。
label.en: Time to reach in and see what we find.
